summary: Ansible can manage Windows hosts over SSH, supported since Ansible 2.8 and officially supported since 2.18. SSH is easier to use outside a domain, supports key authentication, and transfers files faster.
questions: Can I use SSH instead of WinRM to manage Windows servers?
Since which Ansible version is SSH to Windows officially supported?
Why would I pick SSH over WinRM for Windows hosts?
Does SSH to Windows support key-based authentication?

answer_card.title: Using SSH to manage Windows hosts
answer_card.answer_md:
Ansible supports SSH as a connection to Windows hosts. It has worked since Ansible 2.8 and has been officially supported since 2.18.

Why you might prefer it:
- It is easier to set up for hosts that are not in a domain.
- It supports key-based authentication.
- File transfers are faster.
